description_en: Queries the custom topic categories of a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定产品的自定义Topic类
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-product-topic --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key HMyB0000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryProductTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product whose custom topic categories you want to query
parameters.name: product_key

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ProductTopicInfo.description_en: The list of topic category information returned if the call was successful. For more information, see ProductTopicInfo below
ProductTopicInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的Topic类信息列表。详情参见以下ProductTopicInfo

Codec.description_en:
Specifies whether data compression or decompression is enabled for the custom topic.
Valid values:

compress: compression.
decompress: decompression.

For more information about data compression, see [Data compression]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html）
Codec.description_zh:
是否开启自定义Topic数据压缩或解压缩。
取值：

compress：压缩。
decompress：解压缩。

数据压缩功能详细内容，请参见[数据压缩]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html）

Desc.description_en: The description of the topic category

EnableProxySubscribe.description_en:
Indicates whether proxy subscription is enabled.
Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled.

After proxy subscription is enabled, IoT Platform queries the topics with proxy subscription enabled and subscribes to them on behalf of the device when the device connects to IoT Platform
EnableProxySubscribe.description_zh:
是否开启代理订阅。
取值：

true：开启。
false：不开启。

开启代理订阅后，设备与物联网平台建连时，物联网平台查询已开启代理订阅的Topic，帮助设备完成订阅

Id.description_en: The ID of the topic category

Operation.description_en:
The operation permissions of the device on the topic category. Valid values:
0: publish
1: subscribe
2: publish and subscribe
Operation.description_zh:
设备对该Topic类的操作权限，取值：
0：发布
1：订阅
2：发布和订阅

TopicShortName.description_en: The custom topic category of the product

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
